431	    fn on_resolve(&self, state: &mut GameState, object_id: ObjectId, targets: &[Target], _registry: &CardRegistry) {

433	        // Default for permanents: move to battlefield.
434	        let card_data = self.card_data();
435	        if card_data.card_types.iter().any(|t| t.is_permanent()) {

437	            // If this is a planeswalker, set starting loyalty counters.
438	            if let Some(loyalty) = self.starting_loyalty() {
439	                // For X-cost planeswalkers, the x_value is already set on the object.
440	                let x = state.get_object(object_id).and_then(|o| o.x_value).unwrap_or(0);

442	                    x
443	                } else {
444	                    loyalty
445	                };
446	                state.add_counters(object_id, crate::types::CounterType::Loyalty, total);
447	            }
448	        }
449	    }
